test.bonusstring: If successful any locked door unlocks instantly; if failed you do not alert anyone.

action.notes: Rolled by the sprite (Resonance + Hacking; sprite Resonance = level).

action.name: Steal (Fault Sprite)
action.keywords: steal ic power program fault sprite

test.bonusstring: Steal an IC power or program; next use you can use the stolen goods instead, or a passive activates next turn.

action.notes: Rolled by the sprite.

action.name: Exploit (Fault Sprite)
action.keywords: exploit weakness fault sprite cybercombat bonus

test.dice: {Spirit: Force} + {Cybercombat} v. Data Processing x2, Data Processing + INT or REA + INT
test.bonusstring: Net hits give the sprite +2 to its Cybercombat against that device or persona.

action.notes: Rolled by the sprite (Resonance + Cybercombat).

action.name: Active Analytics
action.keywords: active analytics radar pulse locator alert agents closing

test.bonusstring: GM may call for this roll when agents are closing in on your location.

action.notes: Optional sprite power.

action.name: Resist Resonance Pool
action.keywords: resonance pool dragged resist realm

test.dice: {WIL} + {Icon: Attack} v. threshold equal to pool rating
test.bonusstring: Resist being dragged into a resonance pool.

action.notes: Alternatively Strength x2 (book: "for VR and hot sim you might make Strength x2").

action.name: Build Resonance Home
action.keywords: ai resonance home house build host create

test.bonusstring: Create a new house in the resonance; roll 4 times, once for each matrix attribute (max 15).

action.notes: Glitch: start over. Critical glitch: alerts MAC agents to your location.

action.name: AI Disinfection
action.keywords: ai disinfection heal matrix damage depth

test.bonusstring: Instead of the Disinfection action, an AI can roll Depth + Software which does exactly the same: heal matrix damage by successes.

action.name: Low Profile
action.keywords: low profile ai hide ip erase quality

test.dice: {DEP} + {Software} v. Data Processing x2 or Data Processing + INT
test.bonusstring: After a hacking action, hide your IP immediately without an Erase IP action.

action.name: Emulate Device Attribute
action.keywords: ai depth emulate device attribute boost aid

test.dice: {DEP} + {Software} v. Firewall x2 or Firewall + LOG
test.bonusstring: Add half of an owned or hacked device's matrix attribute to your own (max 15) or to the matching physical/mental attribute for up to net hits actions.

action.name: Reset Ownership
action.keywords: ai reset ownership take over device owner

test.dice: {DEP} + {Computer} v. extended threshold Device Rating + Firewall
test.bonusstring: Take over a fully hacked device you are jumped into or running on; dump-shocks the original owner if jumped in.

action.notes: 1 Combat Turn interval. Failure/glitch alerts the owner; critical glitch link-locks you and alerts the owner, or bricks you.

action.name: Create Advanced Program
action.keywords: advanced program create modify ai craft

test.bonusstring: Modify a regular program into its advanced counterpart.

action.notes: 8 hour interval. Requires the regular counterpart.

action.name: Register Advanced Program
action.keywords: register advanced program ai pulse

test.bonusstring: Register an advanced program to the matrix so its use no longer creates pulses.

action.notes: 1 day interval.

action.name: Medic (Advanced Program)
action.keywords: medic toolbox heal ai ic sprite advanced program

test.bonusstring: Heal AIs, ICs and sprites a number of boxes equal to your hits.

action.notes: Only once on the same set of wounds.

action.name: Set VI Crystal Attribute
action.keywords: vi crystal parameters mental attribute program nanocrystal

test.dice: {LOG} + {Software} v. threshold equal to crystal rating
test.bonusstring: Set crystal parameters: rolled for every mental attribute of the VI.

action.notes: 6 day interval. Requires a crystal interface.

action.name: Program VI Skill
action.keywords: vi skill program add install nanocrystal

test.dice: {LOG} + {Software} v. threshold equal to crystal rating
test.bonusstring: Program a skill into a VI (also used to add a new skill in place of a dismantled one).

action.notes: 1 day interval per skill. Personality traits take one day each (no roll).

action.name: Dismantle VI Skill
action.keywords: vi skill remove dismantle uninstall

test.dice: {LOG} + {Software} v. threshold equal to skill rating
test.bonusstring: Dismantle a chosen VI skill.

action.notes: 1 day interval.

action.name: VI Crystal Fusion
action.keywords: vi fusion crystal chassis robot android

test.dice: {Icon: Rating} * 2 v. threshold set by chassis Body x2 roll
test.bonusstring: The crystal fuses with the chassis; the threshold is set once by rolling chassis Body x2.

action.notes: Rolled by the crystal (rating x2). 3 day interval.

action.name: Craft Nanite Fabricator
action.keywords: nanite fabricator craft build grey goo

test.bonusstring: Craft a nanite fabricator (requires 5 TL4 spare parts).

action.notes: 1 day interval. Produces 1 tiny swarm per 1 day / rating.

action.name: Reconfigure Nanite Skill
action.keywords: nanite swarm skill reconfigure install uninstall

test.dice: {LOG} + {Software} v. threshold equal to skill rating
test.bonusstring: Uninstall a swarm skill, then the same roll installs another one.

action.notes: 1 day interval.

action.name: Create Nanite Schematic
action.keywords: nanite schematic blueprint design create

test.bonusstring: Turn your own design into a schematic nanites can build.

action.name: Build Resonance Monitor
action.keywords: resonance monitor build craft tl5

test.bonusstring: Build a resonance monitor (requires 2 TL5 spare parts).

action.notes: 1 day interval.

action.name: Assist AI Skill Development
action.keywords: ai skill development help programmer assist creation

test.bonusstring: Programmers add their hits to the new AI's Depth x2 dice pool for a skill.

action.notes: Must be rolled for every skill the AI wants.

action.name: Create AI Limit (Software)
action.keywords: ai limit create software

test.bonusstring: One of three extended tests building an AI limit; total hits of all three = the limit's hit points.

action.notes: 1 week interval. Glitch: AI must choose its do-nots. Critical glitch: AI goes insane.

action.name: Create AI Limit (Hardware)
action.keywords: ai limit create hardware

test.bonusstring: One of three extended tests building an AI limit; total hits of all three = the limit's hit points.

action.notes: 1 week interval. Glitch: AI must choose its do-nots. Critical glitch: AI goes insane.

action.name: Create AI Limit (Computer)
action.keywords: ai limit create computer

test.bonusstring: One of three extended tests building an AI limit; total hits of all three = the limit's hit points.

action.notes: 1 week interval. Glitch: AI must choose its do-nots. Critical glitch: AI goes insane.

action.name: Break AI Limit
action.keywords: ai limit break unlimited hack

test.dice: {LOG} + {Hacking} v. threshold equal to the limit's hit points
test.bonusstring: Break an AI's limit to make it unlimited.

action.notes: 1 month interval. The AI can defend like against normal hacking.

action.name: Restore AI Limit
action.keywords: ai limit restore repair

test.bonusstring: An AI restores hit points of its limit.

action.notes: 1 week interval.

action.name: Build Nanocrystal Interface
action.keywords: nanocrystal interface build ai craft

test.bonusstring: Create a nanocrystal interface (requires 2 TL5 parts) that connects to the matrix or any hardware.

action.notes: 1 day interval; no threshold given.

action.name: Unlimited AI Sanity Check
action.keywords: unlimited ai sanity insanity check madness

test.bonusstring: GM occasionally requires this; if you ever fail you become insane.

action.name: Core Manifestation Survival
action.keywords: core manifestation projection destroyed survive routine

test.bonusstring: When your energy projection is destroyed; on failure your core is destroyed too.

action.name: Location Calculation
action.keywords: location calculation teleport routine

test.dice: {LOG} + {INT} v. threshold 1 per 100 m (visited) or 2 per 100 m (not visited)
test.bonusstring: Teleport yourself and up to 6 allies (or cargo) to any location.

action.notes: On failure take 1d6 unsoakable damage per 100 m travelled and lose 10% of cargo per 100 m.
